ModMetaData.name: Defaults：自定义儿童阶段兼容修复
ModMetaData.author: WhiteGiverMa
ModMetaData.description:
修复 Defaults 正式版在自定义儿童阶段、机械体与动物上的工作优先级和生日策略异常。仅把工作优先级与生日策略中的两个原版 HumanlikeChild 查询改为按 developmentalStage.Child() 识别；没有儿童阶段时安全跳过对应年龄分支。不改工坊 DLL、原版全局方法或存档，不返还未成功生成的产物。
Fixes Defaults stable work-priority and birthday-policy errors for custom child life stages, mechanoids and animals. Replaces only two HumanlikeChild lookups with developmentalStage.Child() semantics; races without a child stage safely skip the corresponding age checks. Does not edit Workshop DLLs, global vanilla methods or saves, and does not refund failed products.
